title: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation

translated_title: Anvil：通过知识循环实现可扩展的具身空间智能
translated_abstract: 具身空间智能所需的能力远不止视觉识别：模型必须能够定位实体、推理实体之间的关系，并以与行动相关的形式表达这些知识。然而，联合训练可能会将不同阶段所需的知识混为一谈，因为监督信号被割裂在不兼容的几何输出与语义输出之间。我们提出Anvil，一个面向具身空间智能的、涵盖数据生成、训练与基准测试的统一框架。（1）Anvil-Gen是一个异构数据飞轮，结合了形式化专属生成、跨阶段一致性验证和失败驱动的召回，覆盖11种“定位—关系—行动”形式。（2）Anvil-Ben为学习多样化的具身空间能力提供场景对齐的监督，并提供与场景关联的评估方法，能够区分阶段性能力与误差传播。（3）Anvil-MOPD是一个90亿参数的学生模型，通过知识蒸馏整合异构空间知识。
tldr: Anvil提出了一个具身空间智能统一框架，通过异构数据飞轮Anvil-Gen生成多样化训练数据、借助场景对齐的Anvil-Ben进行监督与评估区分阶段能力与误差传播、并用蒸馏得到90亿参数的Anvil-MOPD学生模型，从而实现具身空间知识的可扩展循环与整合。
en_tdlr: Anvil is a unified framework for embodied spatial intelligence that scales data generation, training, and benchmarking through a heterogeneous data flywheel (Anvil-Gen), scene-aligned supervision and stage-aware assessment (Anvil-Ben), and a distilled 9B student model (Anvil-MOPD) that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge.
